MEET THE ARTIST / 최유리

Choi Yu Ree

Choi Yu Ree writes warm, reflective folk songs about everyday feelings. In “Forest”, she finds an image for belonging in trees growing together.

BY INDIEK / UPDATED 2026-10-21

Follow via RSS ↗
Listen ↓Inside the lyrics ↓

She won the grand prize at the 29th Yoo Jae-ha Music Contest and made her official debut with the EP Shape in 2020.

“Forest” is about feeling small among other people, and finding a place with them. Choi Yu Ree wrote it for her 2022 single release Stroll. This version is from a Bugs-ker live session.

INSIDE THE LYRICS

Wanting to be a place for someone

  • Belonging
  • Self-doubt

The wish to become a forest carries a question about belonging. The speaker wants to offer someone a place to enter and stay, while remaining uneasy about their own place among the trees. A generous wish and a sense of inadequacy occupy the same image.

The lyric keeps returning to uncertainty, including whether this place is a forest or a sea. That shifting landscape leaves the speaker’s own position unsettled. Offering shelter does not mean they feel secure themselves; the longing to be recognised remains part of the care they want to give.
